Please review these terms carefully. By continuing, you agree to the following:

• GPS Location Tracker shows your phone's position on a map and keeps a location history.
• To work properly, the app may access your device's location while in use.
• Notifications are used for location alerts and reminders.
• Your data stays private and is used only to provide location tracking features.
